Instrument (EN): Digital Activity and Feelings Inventory — original UK 47-rating youth research form
Scales / measured domains (EN): Two components: 23 digital-activity ratings with FIVE domains (Risky Content; Risky Interactions; Social Comparison; Leisure Activities; Social Engagement), plus 24 psychological-reaction ratings with THREE domains (Negative Self-Reactions 7; Positive Reactions 12; Negative Stress Reactions 5). Not one validated 47-question diagnostic score.

Study empirically examines 23 digital activity and 24 feeling items, 5+3 groups; social engagement reliability omega .57, leisure .62. Same late-youth participants later analyzed with DIAS and PEEL.

Instrument (EN): Digital Insight and Agency Scale — original UK 23-item youth digital impact and agency research form
Scales / measured domains (EN): Section I: perceived online impact 9 ratings (6 functional impact items + 3 individual mental-health impact/concern items). Section II: 14 digital risk-management action ratings; exploratory THREE action factors Enhancing Positive Engagement, Coping Actions and Reducing Engagement. The 3 factors are NOT independently validated across all 23 questions.
Research provenance: Tang et al., Int J Methods Psychiatr Res 2026;35:e70053, published 2026-02-09. UK Digital Youth N383 ages 16–25 (mean19.0), original co-design panel n14. Scales / measured domains (EN): Four reported domain scores: Positive Activities (4), Unhealthy Diet (2), Substance Use (3), Negative Social Experiences (5).
